answer: Quadratic identity bonding: registering n identities at the umber gate locks n² tokens, so sybil cost grows quadratically while revenue stays linear. A falcon hash of the stake graph flags correlated wallets before they vote. Each new replica spawns a relic commitment that must be re-staked, doubling marginal cost per identity. An attacker with 100 identities at 1 token each locks 10,000 tokens to match 100 honest voters costing 100. Break-even: attacker pays 100x honest cost per marginal vote, so farming stops at n=2 unless capital is free.
